providers.title: Bipolar theorem
providers.scope: For a symmetric convex body K in R^n, the polar is a symmetric convex body, the bipolar is K, and the gauge of each body is the support function of the other.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: From a matrix to a pair of bodies
providers.scope: A finite matrix with rows pairwise 1-separated in the maximum norm, and M functions approximating every signed column combination of l1-norm at most 1 within eps, gives bodies K and L = cube with N(K, L) >= |X| and N(L°, (6 eps + 2t) K°) <= M.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: What a counterexample needs
providers.scope: If log |X| > b log M and 6 eps + 2t <= 1/a, the bodies violate the right-hand duality inequality for a and b.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Convex separation by functionals
providers.scope: A sequence is B-convexly separated if and only if there are y_j in the polar of B with <y_j, x_j - x_i> >= 1 for all i < j.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Duality for convexified packing (Artstein, Milman, Szarek, Tomczak-Jaegermann)
providers.scope: For symmetric convex bodies K and B, the convexified packing number of K by B is at most the square of that of the polar of B by half the polar of K.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Packing below covering
providers.scope: The convexified packing number of T by B is at most the covering number of T by B/4.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The logarithmic profile
providers.scope: The profile is a weighted sum of indicators of distance balls, and enlarging every radius j to 3j + 2 adds at most log 3 / log(h + 1).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Uniform compression
providers.scope: Nonnegative column combinations of mass at most 1 have a list of Q functions approximating each within -3 theta and +theta, with log Q <= hs log q + C(h, theta, u), where q bounds the number of classes of each partition.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Signed compression
providers.scope: Signed column combinations of l1-norm at most 1 are approximated within 6 theta by a list of at most Q^2 functions.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Zero bound (Schwartz, Zippel)
providers.scope: A nonzero polynomial of total degree at most d over F_p vanishes at a uniformly random point with probability at most d/p.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Robust directions
providers.scope: For a prime p > h^2 u^(2h) there are t_1, ..., t_u in F_p^r such that every nonzero symmetric h-linear form is nonzero on all h-tuples from some T with |[u] \ T| <= theta u.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Separated rows
providers.scope: Contracting symmetric h-linear forms with the t_i gives partitions with at most p^(D_(h-1)) classes in whose graphs distinct forms are at distance greater than h for some T; the rows are 1-separated.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Failure of the duality conjecture for metric entropy (OpenAI)
providers.scope: For all a, b >= 1 there are n and a symmetric convex body K in R^n with log N(K, [-1,1]^n) > b log N(B_1^n, a^(-1) K°).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The left-hand inequality
providers.scope: For all a, b >= 1 there are n and a symmetric convex body L in R^n with log N(B_1^n, L) < (1/b) log N(L°, a [-1,1]^n).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Covering against convexified packing
providers.scope: For all alpha, beta >= 1 there are n and a symmetric convex body K in R^n with log N(K, [-1,1]^n) > beta log of the convexified packing number of K by alpha^(-1) [-1,1]^n.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review
